claim_text: The BSC builder model gives a builder responsibility for constructing a candidate block from eligible transaction or bundle flow and ordering that block content.
required_evidence: BEP-322 or current official builder specification; actor capability matrix

claim_text: Some block or transaction-context RNG patterns can produce a predictable or influenceable outcome under at least one declared actor capability.
required_evidence: Pinned pre-state, scenario trace, successful replay and outcome decoder

claim_text: Builder capabilities can increase exploitability relative to the searcher-only baseline for at least some confirmed weak-RNG scenarios.
required_evidence: Paired canonical and manipulated replay on identical context_id values; delta_p_win or delta_EV

claim_text: Under a named cost model, there is a prize or value-at-risk threshold at which a declared manipulation strategy changes net_profit from non-positive to positive.
required_evidence: Observed fee fields, labeled modeled costs, prize sweep and derived net_profit

claim_text: The primary safe reference reduces exploitability under the same replay contexts, workload and capability levels.
required_evidence: Paired weak-RNG and safe-reference replays with matching context_id values
